imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The exercise-mat guide uses three accurate category text links; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product image is required.

searchConsole.signal: Five homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.4, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster; the submitted sitemap snapshot showed 26 URLs and zero indexed URLs.
searchConsole.decision: The queryless homepage sample is too small to support a Data-led page. Today's portfolio therefore uses one citation-worthy authority expansion and two unrelated evergreen explorations while reinforcing three hubs, twelve reciprocal paths, the Library and sitemap discovery.
searchConsole.ignored: The five homepage impressions, HTTP homepage variant and aggregate average position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or another variation on an existing topic.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow category text links appear only on the exercise-mat guide. The records and comb-and-hairbrush guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy household-record decision matrix and destruction log that separates current-use records, tax support, ownership and warranty proof, vital documents, active disputes and lawful destruction holds.
authority.cluster: Household documentation, identity protection and evidence continuity, with reciprocal paths from emergency documents, identity-theft recovery, warranties and consumer disputes; the other pages strengthen floor-training and practical hair-tool clusters.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for FTC consumer education and IRS taxpayer education; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions in Life, Fitness and Grooming: which household records to retain or destroy, which exercise mat fits a particular body/room/routine, and which comb or hairbrush geometry suits a specific styling task. Only the equipment guide is commercial, and none follows the weak Search Console sample.
